concurrency: Exactly one writer per run; append and finalize are serialized within that writer; the reader is a separate read-only process/stage.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-002, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-02/ARGUS2-ARCH-12 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Append validated events to a versioned JSONL stream (one canonical JSON object per line).
Publish an atomic JSON run manifest carrying artifact identities, sizes and content hashes, writer state, event count/hash and the caller-declared obligations.
Claim complete evidence only when every declared obligation and every integrity check pass; otherwise classify the run explicitly incomplete with reason codes.
Report stream closure and evidence completeness as separate facts.
state_ownership: Owns the append-only JSONL stream and the manifest lifecycle; owns the authoritative event count/stream hash and the published evidence status until a successor candidate supersedes the run.
title: ARGUS2-SR-002-CMP allocation - Versioned event stream and atomic run manifest
